AI & Automation Save hours

Replace manual work with AI systems and automations that run themselves. Lead gen, email replies, data entry, reporting. Whatever your team keeps repeating, we automate it. Clients typically claw back 10+ hours a week per person.

Sales Automation & Data Data

How We Work

How any Autoeight project gets built

Whether it's an AI workflow, a CRM integration, a learning platform or a website, every project follows the same four stages. You always know where we are and what's coming next.

1

Discovery

We sit down with the people who know how your business actually runs, map out what's happening now, and find where time and money are being wasted. Then we agree what a good result looks like.

2

Design & Build

We design the system around your real workflow and build it in phases, so you see something usable quickly instead of waiting months for a big reveal.

3

Integrate & Launch

We plug it into the rest of your stack. CRM, accounts, email, calendar, whatever else you're already using. Then we test it, train your team and go live.

4

Support & Training

We stick around. Ongoing training for your team, monitoring, tweaks and new features whenever you need them. One long term partner instead of a new agency every six months.

What we've built for clients

PropTech + AI
Northbrick Property. Estate Agency Platform

Independent estate agents were losing leads in their own inbox. We built one platform that unifies every enquiry channel, classifies it with AI, and chases it automatically.

Enquiries land across 14 channels. Web forms, Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp, SMS. Nobody triages them properly. Reapit and Alto are priced and built for the chains, not for independents. So we built Northbrick: a full estate agency platform with a branded public site, a unified inbox across every channel, Claude AI classifying every inbound by type and urgency, automated chase sequences that send from the agent's own mailbox, and viewings tied to the calendar with two-way sync. Multi-tenant from day one, AI-native from day one. Any independent agency can walk through the live build and see exactly what they'd get on their own brand.

14Inquiry channels unified
AIOn every inbound
9Admin modules shipped
AI Automation + Sales Enablement
Matrix TSL. Education Equipment Manufacturer

Sales reps were spending 3+ hours a day on manual research. We cut that to 15 minutes with one AI-powered platform.

Matrix TSL's sales team was losing time switching between HubSpot, LinkedIn and spreadsheets to find and qualify leads across UK universities. We pulled everything into one platform. An AI assistant that matches products to course curricula, a live CRM dashboard, automated lead discovery and 30+ industry news feeds so the team spots opportunities early. They now start every morning knowing exactly who to call and why.

3hrsSaved per rep per day
29Tools consolidated
30+Lead sources monitored
Web Design + Local SEO
TM Joinery Ltd. Construction & Joinery Services

From zero inbound leads to ranking on Google across 6 regions. With quote requests coming in weekly on autopilot.

TM Joinery relied entirely on word of mouth. No website, no Google presence, no way for new customers to find them online. We built them a site designed to get enquiries, with full technical SEO, structured data for Google rich results and an automated quote request system. Within weeks they were showing up in local search across Glasgow, Eaglesham, East Renfrewshire and three surrounding areas. Leads now come in through the site without anyone chasing referrals.

E-Commerce + Email Automation
The Dice Tavern. Specialist Retail & E-Commerce

Marketplace fees eliminated. Customer follow-up fully automated. Average order value up through intelligent cross-selling.

This specialist retailer was losing margin on every sale to marketplace fees and had no direct relationship with customers. We built them a custom e-commerce platform with Stripe payments, a 4 stage automated email sequence (confirmation, dispatch, follow up, review request) and a cross sell engine that suggests relevant products at checkout. Higher margins, customer emails that still feel personal, and a 4.9 star rating off the back of well timed review requests.

4.9★Customer satisfaction

Why Integration Matters

Disconnected tools are costing your business every day

Most businesses use 10+ software tools and hardly any of them talk to each other. Data gets copied between systems by hand, things get missed, and your team spends hours on stuff that should take seconds.

We plug your existing tools together so data flows between them automatically. When something happens in one tool, the right actions fire in the others. Nothing gets missed.

  • Eliminate manual data entry between platforms.
  • Trigger automated workflows when events happen in any tool.
  • Keep CRM records always up to date automatically.
  • Sync contacts, deals, and communications across all platforms.
  • Build single sources of truth for your data.
  • Connect any combination of tools your business uses.
